goals.title: Rush Hour Combo: 8,000
goals.description: Land a single combo worth 8,000 points.

goals.title: Collect S-K-A-T-E
goals.description: The letters are on the lines: the pair ledge, the hubba, under the Line, the station rail and out on the monorail beam.

goals.title: Lunch Run: 6 Pizza Slices
goals.description: Grab six slices from the corners of downtown.

goals.title: Ten Out
goals.description: Ollie the City Hall ten-stair and grab the 10 coin in the air.

goals.title: Fountain Clip
goals.description: Hit the bump and clear the corner of the fountain for the F coin.

goals.title: Station 24
goals.description: Jump the station's 24-stair from the platform and grab the 24 coin.

goals.title: The Secret Tape
goals.description: Somewhere behind a fence in the alleys, someone left a tape. Find the way in.

goals.title: Ride The Line: 5 Second Grind
goals.description: Hold one grind for 5 seconds (the monorail beams go a long way).
